notes: §1985:VII.2.7.2 prints PADDING CHARACTER IS { data-name-1 | literal-1 }, PADDING the one underlined word. paddingCharacterClause parses it with CHARACTER and IS optional; BindFileControl hands it to CapturePadding, which reads literal-1 (figurative and symbolic-character forms included) and takes data-name-1 through ClauseDataName (no subscript or reference modification, COBOL2024), ResolveFiles resolves it with its qualifiers (COBOL1639 for an undefined, ambiguous or wrongly qualified name) and ScreenPaddingDataName applies SR3; ScreenClauseRepetition refuses a second clause (COBOL2423) and VisitPaddingCharacterClause leaves it alone at 85. This closes PB5070's gap (operand never resolved) and PB5499's (table element). Probes at 85 (work-rs-04/c2): b) no operand COBOL0312, two operands and CHARACTER without PADDING COBOL1970, CHARACTERS COBOL5506, clause twice COBOL2423, PT (1) and PC1 (1:1) COBOL2024; c) X"2A", N"*", "" and a constant-name COBOL0900; d) QUOTE, SPACE, ZERO, HIGH-VALUE, ALL "*", ALL QUOTE, SYM1, ALL SYM1, a one-byte group, PC2 OF G1 and IN G1 all run READ ABCD; "AB", 1, ALL "AB", PIC 9, PIC A, PIC X/, PIC XX, an ODO group and a File Section item COBOL6848; a) an OCCURS item COBOL6848. e) a sibling outside this row: PADDING CHARACTER on an ORGANIZATION RELATIVE or INDEXED file compiles and runs at 85, though §1985:VIII.2.3.2 and §1985:IX.2.3.2 print no such clause; FileControlKeyRules.EntryClauses has no PADDING row, where RECORD DELIMITER on the same files draws COBOL2912. No kb/Work note holds that (it belongs to those format rows). The witness writes PADDING CHARACTER IS "*" on a sequential file and reads one record back. History: until the 1985 re-read 5 (2026-11-14) this row read PARTIAL, naming kb/Work PB5070 (landed); the re-read of main dc1f2dcce8 found that defect fixed by the landing of kb/Work PB5070 and kb/Work PB5499 and records CONFORMS, upheld by an independent refuter (code read: op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-04.json, refuter op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-04-refute.json).

next.reason: §1985:VII.2.7.2 is the clause 'PADDING CHARACTER IS {data-name-1 | literal-1}' of a sequential file control entry. 2023 has no PADDING CHARACTER clause: the clauses of the file control entry, §2023:12.4.5.1 'Format 3 (sequential)', are ASSIGN, ACCESS MODE, FILE STATUS, LOCK MODE, ORGANIZATION, RECORD DELIMITER, RESERVE and SHARING, and the words occur in 2023 only in the prose of §2023:9.1.1 ('Padding characters are added or deleted as necessary'), which states no clause. A 1985 entry with PADDING CHARACTER is refused by a 2023 compiler: REMOVED.
